rule: Opens 3%+ above yesterday's high, closes at or above its open, volume 2x+ normal, above the 50-day average
Closes up 5%+ on 3x+ normal volume while above the 200-day average (like a strong earnings reaction)
The S&P 500 falls 1%+ but this market rises 1%+, while above its 50-day average
After an inside day, closes above the bar before it, in an uptrend (50-day above 200-day)
5-day volume under 60% of normal, then a close above the 20-day high on 1.5x+ volume
Falls 3+ ATR in a day while above the 200-day average, then the next day closes green
